brand_summary.short_description: Notion is an all-in-one AI-powered workspace that blends workflow by providing tools for notes, docs, tasks, and project management, designed to centralize knowledge and streamline work for individuals and teams.

logo_variants.notes: The word 'Notion' in a clean, sans-serif typeface, typically black on white or white on black.
A stylized 'N' or a simple geometric shape, often a black square with a white 'N' or a white square with a black 'N', sometimes appearing as a three-line or grid-like icon.

image_style.description: Clean, minimalist product screenshots showcasing UI, often with integrated illustrations conveying organization and collaboration, and abstract geometric elements.

iconography.notes: Simple, monochromatic icons, consistent with a minimalist UI, often used to represent features or actions within the workspace.

tone_of_voice.label: Human, warm, relatable, simple, contextual
examples: We should speak with our users instead of at them.
Warm and relatable is always better than corporate and cold.
Simple words and sentences are always preferred. Edit ruthlessly.

hero.prompt_short: A clean hero image showcasing Notion's AI-powered workspace UI with diverse use cases, emphasizing collaboration and organization.

pattern.prompt_short: Subtle, minimalist geometric or abstract patterns using Notion's muted brand colors, suitable for backgrounds.

guideline_document.overview: Notion is an adaptable, AI-powered workspace designed to centralize knowledge, streamline projects, and foster collaboration for individuals and teams. Its brand emphasizes simplicity, human-centric communication, and a clean visual aesthetic to empower users to achieve more with less busywork.
dos: Use clear, concise, and human-centric language.
Maintain a warm, relatable, and simple tone of voice.
Showcase the product's versatility and AI capabilities through real-world use cases.
Utilize the clean, minimalist visual style with consistent brand colors and typography.
Prioritize readability and user focus in all designs.
donts: Employ overly corporate jargon or a cold, impersonal tone.
Create cluttered or visually inconsistent designs.
Use unapproved fonts or colors that deviate from the brand palette.
Neglect accessibility standards in design and content.
Focus solely on features without highlighting user benefits.

examples.markup_snippet: Your AI Workspace
One workspace. Zero busywork.

for_image_generation.hero_prompt: A clean hero image for Notion: style=minimalist product screenshots with integrated illustrations; dominant_palette={{primary_colors}}, {{secondary_colors}}; mood=efficient, organized, collaborative; composition: Notion UI showcasing AI features and diverse use cases, with left negative space for headline; no logos; deliver 3 variants; aspect_ratio=16:9; avoid={{negative_keywords}}.
for_image_generation.pattern_prompt: Subtle, minimalist geometric or abstract patterns using Notion's muted brand colors (e.g., #F1F1EF, #787774), tileable, for digital backgrounds; avoid={{negative_keywords}}.
for_image_generation.social_prompt: A social media banner for Notion: style=clean, clear messaging, product screenshots or simple illustrations; dominant_palette={{primary_colors}}, {{secondary_colors}}; mood=empowering, productive; content: highlight 'AI workspace' or 'zero busywork'; deliver 3 variants; sizes={{social_banners.sizes}}; avoid={{negative_keywords}}.

for_html_template_generation.main_prompt: Generate a clean, minimalist HTML landing page template for Notion, incorporating {{primary_colors}}, {{secondary_colors}}, and {{typography.primary_font.name}} (fallback: {{typography.primary_font.web_fallback}}). Include a hero section with the tagline '{{tagline_or_headline.value}}', a clear CTA '{{preferred_cta_phrases[0]}}', a features section highlighting '{{messaging_pillars[0].title}}', '{{messaging_pillars[1].title}}', and '{{messaging_pillars[2].title}}' with corresponding icons (placeholder for now), and a simple footer. Ensure the design is responsive and reflects a human, relatable tone. Use placeholders for images based on {{image_style.description}}.

storage_instructions.save_payload: Store the entire JSON object as a new brand theme.

notes: Color hex codes for secondary colors are representative of Notion's extensive palette; specific CTA and muted colors are inferred for recommendation. Font scale is generalized.
